401.message: [401] {{ifempty(body.message, 'The FoPost API key is missing, invalid or revoked. Reconnect the FoPost connection.')}}

402.message: [402] {{ifempty(body.message, 'This FoPost account has no active subscription.')}}{{if(body.upgrade_url, ' Upgrade your plan at https://fopost.com' + body.upgrade_url + ' and enable the scenario again.', ' Upgrade your plan at https://fopost.com/pricing and enable the scenario again.')}}

403.message: [403] {{ifempty(body.message, 'This FoPost API key is not allowed to perform this action.')}} (code: {{ifempty(body.error, 'forbidden')}})

404.message: [404] {{ifempty(body.message, 'The requested FoPost resource does not exist or is not visible to this API key.')}}

429.message: [429] {{ifempty(body.message, 'The FoPost API rate limit was exceeded.')}}{{if(headers.`retry-after`, ' Retry after ' + headers.`retry-after` + ' second(s).', '')}}
